core_obligations: Cut the support by Fit_0 and reduce to the proper case via F = i_*G
Prove base-change compatibility via affineness of the finite morphism
Conclude finite presentation and flatness of pi_{T,*}F

proof_roadmap.step: Cut the support by Fit_0 and reduce to the proper case via F = i_*G
Prove base-change compatibility via affineness of the finite morphism
Conclude finite presentation and flatness of pi_{T,*}F

difficulty_reason: Prove that for quasi-finite pi: X -> Y over B the functor pi_* sends Cohstack_{X/B} to Cohstack_{Y/B}: verify (a) pi_{T,*}F is finitely presented, flat over B with support proper over B, and (b) base-change compatibility pi_{T',*}pr^*F = pr^*pi_{T,*}F; cut the support out by the zeroth Fitting ideal (proper over B by assumption, of finite presentation by the divisors lemmas), write F = i_*G with G finitely presented and flat (stalk comparison), and replace B by T, X by Z to reduce to X -> B proper; then pi is proper (universally-closed permanence) hence finite (characterize-finite), affine so (b) holds by the affine base-change lemma, pi_{T,*}F is finitely presented by the descent lemma and flat over B by stalks (spaces-cohomology-lemma-stalk-push-finite).
